description: Scoreboard and adoption gates for CYNIC embedding models. Measured slots stay null until the graded bench fills them; selection freezes only on full-corpus proof, reproduced twice.

full_corpus.note: RRF is corpus-fragile (±0.1 for 5 changed chunks); no single frozen value. BM25 0.574 is the drift anchor.

B1_gemma2_q4.why: Same weights as reference: isolates quantization cost. Free speed if quality holds.

provenance_config.head_note: bench harness (wilcoxon_signed_rank, full 0.00-1.00 sweep, trunc2500) ran as uncommitted working-tree changes over this commit
provenance_config.runner_slot_law: each runner enforces n_ctx/--parallel tokens per input; cortex -c 4096 --parallel 2 and compute-01 -c 4096 --parallel 2 give 2048-token slots
provenance_config.lxc106_excluded: no admin access (ssh denied for cynic/titouan/user), ceiling unmeasurable, fails closed on long inputs

calibration_history.nonlinearity_note: ECDF curve over alpha 0.00-1.00 step 0.05 is concave with interior optimum (0.275 at 0.00 rising to 0.532 at 0.60, falling to 0.467 at 1.00); sweep endpoints do not reproduce the pure arms because altitude multipliers and contract floors reorder fused candidates even at alpha 0/1

wilcoxon_best_ecdf_vs_rrf.verdict: significant at 0.05 on 10 decisive pairs; 32/42 ties (mostly double misses) bound the power
wilcoxon_best_ecdf_vs_rrf.method: paired signed-rank, normal approximation with continuity and tie corrections (cynic-eval wilcoxon_signed_rank, unit-tested)

blind_spots.reading: no arm (BM25, dense, RRF, fusion) scores above 0; fixture grades point at content the index never surfaces in top-20; retrieval gap, not fusion failure; follow-up

calibration_history.rrf_regression_note: ordinal RRF (0.4167) underperforms both pure arms on this 42-query fixture; rank fusion is fragile when sparse and dense top-20 disagree; continuous convex dominates at interior alpha

B2_jina_nano_retrieval.why: Retrieval-tuned head on EuroBERT-210m; our task is retrieval. MMTEB 65.5.
B2_jina_nano_retrieval.instruction_risk: Needs task prefixes (retrieval.query:/retrieval.passage:); disadvantaged if pipeline omits them. Covered by TextPipeline per-model config.

B3_jina_small_retrieval.why: Best sub-1B quality (MMTEB 67.0, Qwen3-0.6B base). Quality ceiling.

B4_qwen3_0_6b.why: Raw backbone, Apache-2.0, MTEB ~67.8. Fallback if jina GGUF misbehaves.
B4_qwen3_0_6b.instruction_risk: Qwen3 instruction/chat template may interfere with plain-text embedding; verify template handling before measuring.

B0_minilm_floor.why: Floor baseline: quantifies what small costs.
